**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The document contains no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on Northwind. Clause 12.3 expressly preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service and to conduct business in any field or territory, and records that Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. Clause 12.4 restrains Vendor (not us) from competing with our analytics products, which benefits us and is not flagged. Section 13.4's restrictions are ordinary Service use limits, and the licence in 13.1 is worldwide with no field-of-use limit. No redline proposed.
